pkgmetadata.longdescription: DaVinci Resolve (free edition) from Blackmagic Design: editing, colour, Fusion effects and Fairlight audio. Proprietary and fetch-restricted: Blackmagic hands the archive out only behind a registration form, so it has to be downloaded by hand (see the pkg_nofetch text or the README of this overlay). This is the free edition; media-video/davinci-resolve-studio is the paid one and blocks it.

use.flag: Depend on the ROCm OpenCL runtime (AMD GPUs)
Depend on the Intel compute runtime (OpenCL on Intel GPUs)
Depend on x11-drivers/nvidia-drivers (CUDA + OpenCL); keeps the Blackmagic RAW CUDA decoder
